outcome: resolution of respiratory distress and cyanosis
cohort: A single neonate with a rare complex congenital heart disease including congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries, Ebstein's tricuspid anomaly, and severe coarctation of the aorta.
finding: Balloon angioplasty was an effective intervention for a neonate presenting with a rare combination of complex congenital heart diseases and unstable hemodynamic status.
